## Read in data

## Hanada_2022
Hanada, K. I., Zhao, C., Gil-Hoyos, R., Gartner, J. J., Chow-Parmer, C., Lowery, F. J., ... & Yang, J. C. (2022). A phenotypic signature that identifies neoantigen-reactive T cells in fresh human lung cancers. Cancer Cell, 40(5), 479-493.

```{r}
hanada = read_excel("data/Hanada_2022_Table_S3.xlsx", range = "A4:L17")
hanada = as.data.frame(hanada)
names(hanada)[1:3] = c("cloneType_ID", "antigen_identified", "antigen")

hanada$patient = "Patient1"
hanada$cell_type = "CD8"

dim(hanada)
hanada[1:2,]

read_segment <- function(range1, patient, cell_type){
  dat = read_excel("data/Hanada_2022_Table_S3.xlsx", range = range1)
  dat = as.data.frame(dat)
  names(dat)[1:3] = c("cloneType_ID", "antigen_identified", "antigen")
  
  dat$patient = patient
  dat$cell_type = cell_type
  dat
}

hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A21:L33", "Patient1", "CD4"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A37:L57", "Patient2", "CD8"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A61:L76", "Patient2", "CD4"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A80:L97", "Patient3", "CD8"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A101:L117", "Patient3", "CD4"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A121:L132", "Patient4", "CD8"))
hanada = rbind(hanada, read_segment("A136:L140", "Patient4", "CD4"))

dim(hanada)
hanada[1:2,]

hanada = hanada[,-1]
table(hanada$antigen_identified)
hanada = hanada[hanada$antigen_identified == "Yes",]
hanada$antigen_type = "neoantigen"

hanada = hanada[,c("TRAV", "TRAJ", "CDR3", "TRBV", "TRBD", "TRBJ", 
                   "CDR3B", "antigen", "antigen_type", "Mutated", 
                   "patient", "cell_type")]

names(hanada)[c(3,10)] = c("CDR3A", "epitope")
hanada$study = "Hanada_2022"
hanada$cancer_type = "NSCLC"
dim(hanada)
hanada[1:2,]

table(hanada$patient, hanada$cell_type)
table(table(hanada$CDR3B))
table(hanada$antigen_type)

```

```{r}
lowery$CDR3  = paste(lowery$CDR3A, lowery$CDR3B, sep=":")
```

## Sudmeier_2022

Sudmeier, L. J., Hoang, K. B., Nduom, E. K., Wieland, A., Neill, S. G., Schniederjan, M. J., ... & Hudson, W. H. (2022). Distinct phenotypic states and spatial distribution of CD8+ T cell clonotypes in human brain metastases. Cell Reports Medicine, 3(5), 100620.

All the TCRs reported by Sudmeier et al. are not cancer reactive, but are CEFX (a microbe pool) reactive. 

```{r}

sudmeier[,j_gene := tcr_info[,2]]

l1 = sudmeier
```

## Veatch_2022

Veatch, J. R., Lee, S. M., ... & Riddell, S. R. (2022). Neoantigen-specific CD4+ T cells in human melanoma have diverse differentiation states and correlate with CD8+ T cell, macrophage, and B cell function. Cancer cell, 40(4), 393-409.


### A function to extract CDR3 from DNA sequence. 

```{r}
table(str_sub(hanada$CDR3B, 1, 2))
table(str_sub(hanada$CDR3B, -1, -1))

table(str_sub(lowery$CDR3B, 1, 2))
table(str_sub(lowery$CDR3B, -1, -1))

table(str_sub(sudmeier$CDR3B, 1, 2))
table(str_sub(sudmeier$CDR3B, -1, -1))

DNA2CDR3 <- function(x){
  
  cdr3_all = rep("", length(x))
  
  # remove those with "N" in the DNA sequence
  gN = grep("N", x)
  length(gN)
  
  if(length(gN) > 0){ 
    cdr3_all[gN] = NA
    x = x[-gN]
  }
  table(is.na(cdr3_all))

  aa = as.character(translate(DNAStringSet(x)))

  CDR3 = str_sub(aa, start = 1L, end=-3L)
  
  start_pos = str_locate(CDR3, "CA|CS")
  w2rm = which(is.na(start_pos[,1]))
  start_pos[w2rm,1] = 1
  CDR3 = str_sub(CDR3, start = start_pos[,1], end=-1L)
  CDR3[w2rm] = NA
  
  if(length(gN) > 0){
    cdr3_all[-gN] = CDR3
  }else{
    cdr3_all = CDR3
  }
  
  print("first two AA:")
  print(table(str_sub(cdr3_all, 1, 2), useNA="ifany"))
  print("last AA:")
  print(table(str_sub(cdr3_all, -1, -1), useNA="ifany"))
  print("CDR3 length:")
  print(table(nchar(cdr3_all), useNA="ifany"))
  
  cdr3_all
}
```

### Collect TCR data

The number of TCRs responding to neoantigen, self-antigen, and viral antigen can be found in Figure 1I of Veatch et al.

```{r}
patients = c("X422", "X197", "X205", "X198")

veatch = NULL

for(p1 in patients){
  if(p1 == "X205"){
    dat = read_excel("data/x205 adaptive 8-17-20.xlsx")
    dat = data.frame(dat)
  }else{
    dat = read_excel("data/Veatch_2022_Table_S2.xlsx", skip = 2, 
                   sheet=p1)
    dat = data.frame(dat)
  }
  dim(dat)
  dat[1:3,1:min(15,ncol(dat))]

  names(dat)[1] = "Rearrangement"
  table(nchar(dat$Rearrangement))
  
  if(p1 == "X197" || p1 == "X198"){
    dat$Rearrangement = str_sub(dat$Rearrangement, start=3)
  }
  
  dat$CDR3 = DNA2CDR3(dat$Rearrangement)
  
  if(p1 == "X422"){
    w2kp = which(dat$antigen != "")
    df1  = dat[w2kp, c("CDR3", "antigen")]
    df1$antigen_type = "neoantigen"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)
    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
  }
  
  if(p1 == "X197"){
    w2kp = which(dat$clone == "BRAF")
    df1 = data.frame(CDR3=dat$CDR3[w2kp], antigen="BRAF")
    df1$antigen_type = "neoantigen"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)
    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
    
    w2kp = which(dat$viral == "viral")
    df1 = data.frame(CDR3=dat$CDR3[w2kp], antigen=NA)
    df1$antigen_type = "viral"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)
    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
  }

  if(p1 == "X205"){
    w_neoag = which(!is.na(dat$clone.neo))
    w_self  = which(dat$self == "self")
    w_viral = which(dat$viral.pd.1.int == "viral" | dat$viral.pd.1.low == "viral")
    
    df1  = dat[w_neoag, c("CDR3", "clone.neo")]
    names(df1)[2] = "antigen"
    df1$antigen[df1$antigen == "unknown"] = NA

    df1$antigen_type = "neoantigen"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)

    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
    
    df1  = dat[w_self, c("CDR3", "self")]
    names(df1)[2] = "antigen"
    df1$antigen_type = "self"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1$antigen = NA
    df1 = unique(df1)

    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)

    df1  = dat[w_viral, c("CDR3", "viral.pd.1.int")]
    names(df1)[2] = "antigen"
    df1$antigen = NA
    df1$antigen_type = "viral"
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)

    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
  }

  if(p1 == "X198"){
    w2kp = which((!is.na(dat$CD4.clone...2)))
    df1  = dat[w2kp, c("CDR3", "CD4.clone...2")]
    names(df1)[2] = "antigen"
    df1$antigen_type = "neoantigen"
    df1$antigen_type[which(df1$antigen == "Viral")] = "viral"
    df1$antigen[which(df1$antigen == "Viral")] = NA
    df1$patient = p1
    df1 = unique(df1)

    veatch = rbind(veatch, df1)
  }
}

dim(veatch)
veatch[1:2,]


l1 = veatch
veatch = data.frame(TRAV=NA, TRAJ=NA, CDR3A=NA, 
                    TRBV=NA, TRBD=NA, TRBJ=NA, CDR3B=l1$CDR3,
                    antigen=l1$antigen, antigen_type=l1$antigen_type, 
                    epitope="", patient=l1$patient, 
                    cell_type="CD4", study="Veatch_2022", 
                    cancer_type="Melanoma")

dim(veatch)
veatch[1:2,]

table(veatch$antigen_type, veatch$patient)

```


## Combine data across studies

```{r}
df = hanada
df = rbind(df, lowery)
df = rbind(df, caushi)
df = rbind(df, sudmeier)
df = rbind(df, veatch)

dim(df)
df[1:2,]
table(df$study, useNA="ifany")
table(df$antigen_type, useNA="ifany")
table(df$study, df$cell_type, useNA="ifany")
table(df$study, df$cancer_type, useNA="ifany")

fwrite(df, "data/cancer_reactive_TCRs.tsv", sep="\t")
```


## Compare CDR3 between cancer TCRs vs. other TCRs

### CDR3 length
```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
viral_grp = c("viral_Influenza", "viral_CEF")

df$CDR3B_len = nchar(df$CDR3B)
df$`antigen_type`[df$`antigen_type` %in% viral_grp] = "viral"

table(df$study, df$antigen_type)

df1 = as.data.frame(table(df$CDR3B_len, df$study=="Sudmeier_2022"))
names(df1) = c("CDR3B length", "Sudmeier_2022", "freq")
df1$study = "others"
df1$study[which(df1$Sudmeier_2022 == TRUE)] = "Sudmeier 2022"

df1$relative_freq = NA
for(a1 in unique(df1$study)){
  wa = which(df1$study == a1)
  df1$relative_freq[wa] = df1$freq[wa]/sum(df1$freq[wa])
}

ggplot(df1, aes(x = `CDR3B length`, y = relative_freq, 
                fill=study)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "CDR3B length")

w2use = which(df$study != "Sudmeier_2022")
df1 = as.data.frame(table(df$CDR3B_len[w2use], df$antigen_type[w2use]))
names(df1) = c("CDR3B length", "antigen type", "freq")

df1
df1 = df1[df1$`antigen type` != "self",]

df1$relative_freq = NA
for(a1 in unique(df1$`antigen type`)){
  wa = which(df1$`antigen type` == a1)
  df1$relative_freq[wa] = df1$freq[wa]/sum(df1$freq[wa])
}

ggplot(df1, aes(x = `CDR3B length`, y = relative_freq, 
                fill=`antigen type`)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "CDR3B length for all TCRs")

t1 = table(df$CDR3B_len[w2use], df$antigen_type[w2use])
t1 = t1[,-2]

t1
chisq.test(t1)
```

### Use of amino acids for all studies

```{r fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}
aas = strsplit(df$CDR3B, split="")
aas_by_antigen = tapply(aas, df$antigen_type, function(x){unlist(x)})

n_aa = lapply(aas_by_antigen, length)
n_aa

df2 = data.frame(aa=c(aas_by_antigen$neoantigen, aas_by_antigen$viral), 
                 antigen = rep(c("neoantigen", "viral"), 
                               times=c(n_aa$neoantigen, n_aa$viral)))
dim(df2)
df2[1:2,]

t1 = table(df2$aa, df2$antigen)
dim(t1)
t1

chisq.test(t1)

t1 = t(t(t1)/colSums(t1))
t1 = round(data.matrix(t1),3)
dim(t1)
t1[1:2,]

df1 = data.frame(aa = rownames(t1), neoantigen = t1[,1], viral = t1[,2])
dim(df1)
df1

ggplot(df1, aes(x=viral, y=neoantigen, label = aa)) + 
  geom_point(color="orange") + geom_text_repel() + 
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, color="grey")

```
